svg.text: My goal is to creating 3d asset , animation,vfx. Also work with dev , leading artists to delivery art asset and exploring creativity.

g.text: Worked on game animations for Ejen Ali: Agents' Arena.Created 3D assets for multiple client projects across various genres.Produced 2D animations for Komuniti Kita using Spine 2D.Developed a large volume of Spine 2D animations for the Web3 project Defiantz NFT.

Roblox Developer / Lead Artist• Began Roblox development career focusing on 3D asset creation and leading the art team• Created low-poly 3D assets, Environment asset , humanoid UGC items, animations, and VFX• Contributed to Roblox projects including - Gummy Bear Simulator ,Monster Rider Simulator , Escape Momster Yaey ,Sharp shooter (FPS game) and more• Acted as Lead Artist: – Delivered tasks within timeframe and maintained production schedule – Provided creative direction and constructive feedback to artists – Assigned tasks and coordinated with other departments to ensure smooth workflow• Trained and mentored new hires and interns to improve their technical and creative skills
